review.method: independently retrieve original-publisher values for the reference observation dates; compare within reference display precision of 0.005, including reference values displayed as zero; retain full original-publisher precision so nonzero source values remain nonzero in the packet
review.cadence: 15-minute capture attempts, subject to publisher availability
review.freshness: 1200-second maximum elapsed age for both the source capture and successful packet acquisition; this is capture freshness, not every input observation age
review.missing_policy: Fail the attempt on missing, ambiguous, mismatched, stale or restricted evidence; latest never substitutes a preceding successful packet
review.readiness: Original-publisher checks plus the pinned reference review calendar and release checks; individual dates and newer-observation flags stay visible
review.calendar_limit: The reference release calendar currently covers 2026; review and release an updated calendar before its year boundary

metrics.name: Reserve balances with Federal Reserve Banks, weekly average
Standing repo facility accepted amount, morning plus afternoon

time_semantics.observation_date: Period or date to which the publisher value applies
time_semantics.archived_at: First verified insertion into this forward archive; basis for as_of
time_semantics.retrieved_at: Per-source completed download clock; not publication time
time_semantics.history: No pre-launch knowledge reconstructed. Same-date changes are captured differences, not confirmed publisher revision events.

verification.authentication: HTTPS delivery; packet hashes are integrity checks, not publisher signatures
verification.source_receipts: Each publisher response retained by hash; raw source blobs are operator recovery evidence, not a public arbitrary-file API
verification.backup: Encrypted hourly offsite snapshots with exact-snapshot restoration and every-file hash verification; usage data excluded
verification.producer: New manifests identify producer_source_commit and SHA-256 hashes of the generator, publisher parser, observer and reference validator modules. source_commit identifies the separate pinned reference release. Initial manifests without producer fields remain preserved and are bound by the retained activation receipt; they are not rewritten.
